cases.source:
agentflow-beta TB
  flow team["Content Team"]
    flow researcher["Researcher"]
      gather["Gather sources"]@{ shape: task }
    end

    flow writer["Writer"]
      compose["Compose draft"]@{ shape: task }
    end

    researcher --> writer
  end

agentflow-beta TB
  global
    corpus["Shared corpus"]@{ shape: refdoc }
  end

  flow summariser["Summariser"]
    summarise["Summarise"]@{ shape: task }
    summarise -.- corpus
  end

  flow indexer["Indexer"]
    index["Build index"]@{ shape: task }
    index -.- corpus
  end

agentflow-beta LR
global
  policy["Review policy"]@{ shape: refdoc }
end
connector tracker["Issue tracker"]
flow delivery["Delivery"]
  intake["Receive report"]@{ shape: input }
  flow analysis["Analysis"]
    inspect["Inspect changes"]@{ shape: tool }
    review["Review result"]@{ shape: decision }
    inspect --> review
    review -- revise --> inspect
    inspect -.- policy
  end
  publish["Publish result"]@{ shape: action }
  intake --> inspect
  review -- approve --> publish
end
publish --> tracker

upstream.section: Containers; The global block; Edges (combined regression)
